messages:
Maya (People Ops): Following up from today's all-hands Q&A — here are the specific answers we promised around spot bonuses, cross-org promotions, and comp transparency. Drop questions and we'll update the Notion page.

Zoe (IC2): thanks Maya. quick one: what's the process for spot/recognition bonuses? I had a peer nominated for urgent recognition last month.

Ethan (Comp & Benefits): Spot bonuses are separate from the promo/merit cycle. Managers can submit nominations via the spot-bonus form (link below). Target turnaround is 2-3 weeks, requires manager + finance approval. We avoid stacking spot + market adjustment in the same payout window unless exceptional.

Carlos (Eng Manager): for cross-functional promotions (eg: eng -> product-ish role), do we need dual manager sign-off? past cycles felt messy.

Maya (People Ops): for role changes that cross orgs, include both managers in the packet and add an explicit impact statement on scope change. Calibration panel will include a cross-org reviewer. Dual manager sign-off helps speed approvals.

Rahul (SRE): any changes to comp transparency? engineers want more visibility into band medians and ranges.

Ethan (Comp & Benefits): we're publishing anonymized band medians and quartiles in the comp FAQ next week. It won't show individual salaries, just distribution by level & region. Managers will also get a headcount/comp impact preview post-calibration to aid planning.

Zoe (IC2): what about equity refresh nominations after a promo? is there an accelerated path?

Maya (People Ops): promotions don't automatically trigger equity refreshes. Managers can nominate via the refresh form and mark it as "post-promo" if the promo materially changed scope. Those are prioritized but still reviewed separately.

Carlos (Eng Manager): timeline recap for packets? trying to coordinate across teams.

Maya (People Ops): manager packet deadline = May 8 EOD PT. Calibration meetings = May 15-16. Final approvals by May 22. Appeals open for 14 days after the manager conversation. Templates and a short checklist are in the Notion doc.

Rahul (SRE): parental leave top-up question from the ops folks — how does top-up interact with short-term disability in US?

Ethan (Comp & Benefits): short answer: top-up is applied after STD for eligible roles so combined pay aims to approximate full pay for the policy period. We'll post examples by location in the benefits FAQ. For unique cases, people can file a benefits exception ticket.

Zoe (IC2): appeal process — can ICs add new evidence after the conversation with manager?

Maya (People Ops): yes — you have 14 days to submit an appeal with additional docs via the appeal form. Committee = People Ops + 2 non-involved senior managers + Comp rep. Target turnaround = 10 business days.

Carlos (Eng Manager): will we get a draft comp impact before final sign-off to plan hires?

Ethan (Comp & Benefits): yes — managers get an estimated comp & headcount impact snapshot after calibration but before final sign-off. We'll flag big deltas for early discussion.

notion-bot: Templates, forms, and FAQ uploaded: https://redwoodinference.notion.site/People-Ops-Comp-Spot-Promo-1776001234

Maya (People Ops): Office hours next week: Managers Tue 9:30am PT, ICs Thu 3pm PT. Sign-up link in Notion. If you have urgent exceptions, DM Ethan + me. :white_check_mark:
